# Row

`layout/row` &middot; section-level &middot; category: layout

## Purpose

Two to four columns that stay side by side on mobile instead of stacking.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | list of components (content-level) (2 to 4) |  |

## Optional fields

None.

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Equal-width columns that never stack.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX @theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX"` |
| `valign` | one of `top`, `middle`, `bottom` | `"top"` |
| `columnPadding` | spacing | `"0 @spacing.xs"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Renders as a table row, same as desktop. | Fine. Columns get narrow on phones, keep content short. | Swaps via dm-* classes when on the brand surface or background color. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('layout/row', {
  "items": [
    [
      {
        "component": "content/heading",
        "data": {
          "text": "4.9"
        },
        "settings": {
          "level": "h2",
          "align": "center"
        }
      },
      {
        "component": "content/text",
        "data": {
          "text": "Average rating"
        },
        "settings": {
          "level": "caption",
          "align": "center"
        }
      }
    ],
    [
      {
        "component": "content/heading",
        "data": {
          "text": "50K+"
        },
        "settings": {
          "level": "h2",
          "align": "center"
        }
      },
      {
        "component": "content/text",
        "data": {
          "text": "Happy customers"
        },
        "settings": {
          "level": "caption",
          "align": "center"
        }
      }
    ],
    [
      {
        "component": "content/heading",
        "data": {
          "text": "60 days"
        },
        "settings": {
          "level": "h2",
          "align": "center"
        }
      },
      {
        "component": "content/text",
        "data": {
          "text": "Free returns"
        },
        "settings": {
          "level": "caption",
          "align": "center"
        }
      }
    ]
  ]
}) ]]
```
